sentences.ar: بنفس اليوم، كان في رحلة للولاد.
sentences.en: On the same day, there was an outing for the children.
They went by boat to the other bank.

sentences.ar: في مغارة كبيرة هناك بجوف الجبل.
sentences.en: There was a big cave there inside the hill.
They all went in carrying candles.
Tom and Becky wandered from the others.
They were looking at the strange rocks.

sentences.ar: وبعد شوي، ما عادوا يعرفوا الطريق.
sentences.en: And a little later, they no longer knew the way.
